verdict.rationale: Lowenstein's own pages state deal volume: roughly 1,000 venture deals over two years and thousands of venture and growth equity investments a year, ranking it among the five most active VC/PE firms. They also mention priced rounds and early through growth stage financings. However, the priced-round language is framed around representing investors, and stage coverage is described only broadly as 'early through growth stage' rather than seed through late-stage priced rounds. missing for 10: explicit company-side priced equity round coverage from seed through late stage (Series A/B/C+), named representative transactions or case examples, independent corroboration of deal volume.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages

from forming businesses, early through growth stage financings, to ultimately successful and lucrative exits.
